english.note: Use this as the everyday choice for careful attention to every detail, rather than for something merely complete or absolute.
This is the all-purpose choice, especially for work, searches, or checking done with precise attention to detail.
Use 仔細 as the all-purpose choice when stressing careful attention to details in a process or task.
Use this for doing something meticulously, thoroughly, or with close attention to detail.
Use 仔細 when close means careful, attentive, or detailed in examining something.
Use this for the metaphorical sense of being precise and meticulous rather than for a legal investigation.
